title: GDD T-105 — Hito 1 integration: minimal session JOIN → 5 microgames → podium, replay determinism (§17 Hito 1)
description: Wire SessionStateMachine (TASK-024) + MECH_05 (TASK-025) + MECH_04 (TASK-026) + StagePresenter (TASK-027) into a playable Hito 1 scene: JOIN with color claim, a minimal session of 5 microgames alternating REACCIONA/APUNTA definitions (no board — board states pass through), MG_RESULT payouts into the existing ScoreModel, and a simple podium at GAME_OVER. Include the replay-determinism harness at session level: recording (sessionSeed + InputSnapshot sequence) and re-running it produces the identical final state (hash comparison; groundwork for the .bcrp format of Annex D.4 — full file format is T-115, not this ticket). Scene generated by an Editor SceneBuilder menu item (repo convention) so the human can rebuild and UAT. GDD Hito 1 AC: 4 people play a complete session with no verbal explanation; both mechanics' unit ACs green; replay determinism working. Human UAT required (P1/P4 are observational).
acceptance_criteria: A generated scene (SceneBuilder menu item, repo convention) boots to ATTRACT and runs JOIN -> 5 microgames (alternating REACCIONA/APUNTA definitions) -> podium with no manual setup
MG_RESULT feeds the existing ScoreModel payouts and the podium shows the final ranking; session returns to ATTRACT on timeout
Replay determinism at session level: same (sessionSeed, recorded InputSnapshot sequence) reproduces the identical final state via state-hash comparison in the fast suite
Session completes with zero input (all timeouts fire) — no state can hang the machine in the integrated scene
Fast suite green; EditMode/PlayMode smoke for the integrated scene passes
Human UAT: a full session is playable and understandable without verbal explanation (P1: joining to playing in under 60 s; P4: verbs and states readable), recorded as a uat comment on this ticket
